item.title: New Rainbow Six Game Has Permadeath
item.description:
The upcoming Rainbow Six spin-off, Rainbow Six Tactics , will feature permadeath. Gamers will have to plan carefully and strategize in order to make the most of their campaigns in the new Rainbow Six game.

Rainbow Six Tactics was announced just a short time ago at Gamescom Opening Night Live. The next entry in the franchise will be a deviation from the usual formula, as this entry will be turn-based and single-player. Players will be able to use just 15 of the Operators from Rainbow Six Siege 's massive roster, and the limited options will make permadeath all the more difficult.

New Ubisoft Game Release Forgot to Include the Game

Ubisoft launches a game, but fans who were eager to buy it get an unpleasant surprise when they discover they didn't get the game at all.

By Sarah Fields

Rainbow Six Tactics Brings Permadeath to the Formula

In a chat between Martial Potron, Rainbow Six Tactics game director, and IGN, the director took the opportunity to talk about the game's permadeath. Calling it a "must-have" for fans of the tactical game genre, he explained that Rainbow Six Tactics does include permadeath, but the feature is optional. Permadeath will be available across all difficulty levels, and the feature will mean planning carefully when sending out squads. If the feature is enabled and a Rainbow Six Operator is too injured during the campaign, they'll be permanently unavailable for the remainder of it, leaving players to work with whoever they have left. Since each Operator is unique, losing a valuable member early on could make further outings much more difficult.

Potron went into further detail regarding the game as a whole, particularly with the pivot from shooter to tactics game. Potron explained that since the Rainbow series is already a "Smart Shooter" game that requires strategy and thinking before acting for the best outcome, which translates well to a tactics game. The team also took inspiration from the original Rainbow Six when developing how the Breach works. Players can choose in advance how they want to try and enter a location, including methods used, like explosives, to synchronizing Operators' actions for maximum efficiency. As with other Rainbow Six games, destruction of the environment will still play an important role.

From the sound of it, one of the most challenging angles of development was maintaining the uncertainty in a standard Rainbow Six Siege match in a turn-based game. Rainbow Six Tactics is implementing a dynamic fog-of-war system that requires players to utilize scouting, drones, and everything else at their disposal to figure out how to best proceed. Potron described the game's hidden threats as remaining "dangerous without becoming frustrating," in an effort to maintain fairness while still preserving tension.

Rockstar Games Announces Brand-New Detail About GTA 6: Extended Look
New Official Sifu-Like Game with Gun Fu Officially Confirmed for Summer 2027

For now, Rainbow Six Siege fans will have to wait and see if the new game can live up to the hype. Rainbow Six Tactics currently has a release window of 2027, so it may be a year or more before players can actually try it out. In the meantime, regular updates for Rainbow Six Siege are still arriving well into its 11th year, with a major update arriving on September 1. That update will introduce Operation Split Fire and new Operative Noor, plus a new Legend Division in Ranked mode, and a new 3v3 arcade mode.

item.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Parks Floating Festival Week Two Puzzles Guide
item.description:
If you have solved the first two puzzles in the Parks Floating Festival, there are two more to tackle in week two. Disney Dreamlight Valley has just added Puzzles 3 and 4, and one of them even sends you to a new island. Here’s how to solve both Week Two puzzles in the Parks Floating Festival in DDV .

Disney Dreamlight Valley: How to Vote in a Dreamy Contest in the Valleyverse

One of this week's routine duties asks you to vote in a Dreamy Contest in the Valleyverse. Here's how you can do that.

By Umama Ali

Third Puzzle Solution in Dreamlight Valley’s Parks Floating Festival

Adventureland Entrance Puzzle in Parks Floating Festival

To solve the third puzzle, go to the floating festival island and look for the Adventureland arch. It’s located near the big castle in the middle of the island , as shown in the screenshot above. Once you find it, you should walk up to the arch and select the ‘Complete Puzzle’ option.

All that’s needed is to put the puzzle pieces in the right spots. You will need to pick up a piece from the left side, rotate it if needed, and place it on the board on the right. Keep doing this until all the pieces are in place. The screenshot above shows what the completed puzzle should look like. It only took me a few minutes to solve it.

Fourth Puzzle Solution in DDV’s Parks Floating Festival

Jungle Critter Combination Puzzle in Parks Floating Festival

The fourth puzzle becomes available after completing the third one. Once Puzzle 3 is finished, the Adventureland arch will have an ‘Enter’ option instead of ‘Complete Puzzle.’ Interact with it to enter the new island.

Once inside Adventureland, you should follow the path straight ahead and take the first left. Continue along the path and take another left, and you will see the puzzle pillar.

The puzzle has four dials with pictures of a Cobra, Bird, Monkey, and Squirrel, along with the numbers I, II, III, and IV above them. The goal is to count each critter on the island and set the dials to match their numbers.

The correct combination for the 4th Parks Floating Festival puzzle is:

  • I: Cobra
  • II: Bird
  • III: Monkey
  • IV: Squirrel

There is one Cobra, two Birds, three Monkeys, and four Squirrels around the island. Set each dial to the corresponding critter, and a pouch will drop from the pillar. Pick it up to collect the furniture reward and complete the fourth puzzle.

item.title: Upcoming Nintendo Switch 2 Physical Release Switches to Game Key-Cards, Cancels Orders
item.description:
Upcoming Nintendo Switch 2 game Danganronpa 2×2 is changing its physical release from a traditional cartridge to a Game-Key Card and refunding physical purchases. Danganronpa 2×2 publisher Spike Chunsoft revealed the news and explained that the choice to switch wasn't made lightly.

Prior to its release, Nintendo revealed that the Switch 2 would use two separate kinds of cartridges to play games: standard game cartridges, and Game-Key Cards. Game cartridges have the files necessary to play the game onboard, but Game-Key Cards are essentially a download code in a physical form. Game-Key Cards tell the Switch 2 what game to download and need to be inserted in order to play. So far, some games have been released on standard cartridges for the Switch 2, while others have opted for Game-Key Cards.

Nintendo Officially Reveals Brand-New $530 Switch 2 Bundle

Nintendo reveals a new Switch 2 bundle, which will be available in stores shortly after the system's upcoming price increase.

By Marc Deschamps

Danganronpa 2×2 Switches to Game-Key Cards

On social media, publisher Spike Chunsoft revealed that a change had been made regarding the Nintendo Switch 2 release of Danganronpa 2×2 . Previously, physical copies of the game were going to use standard game cartridges on the Nintendo Switch 2. However, the company has now changed its plan, and Switch 2 physical copies will be shipped with a Game-Key Card in all regions the game is sold in. Spike Chunsoft didn't explain why the change was being made, simply stating that it was "unavoidable." As a result of this shift, all Shopify US Store orders of the Nintendo Switch 2 version of the game have been canceled outright.

Gamers in the US who are still interested in playing Danganronpa 2×2 are encouraged to place new orders through the Shopify US store once their refunds are processed. Those who ordered the game through the Shopify UK or EU stores, and any other retail stores, will simply receive their copies with the Game-Key Cards instead. Spike Chunsoft notes that anyone who didn't order from the Shopify US store and wants to change their pre-orders will need to contact the retailer they placed them with.

While some gamers are indifferent to the shift, many have voiced objections to this change. Several have said that they won't be placing a new order for the game when they're refunded, while some others who have purchased from different retailers have promised to cancel. At this time, no announcements regarding changes to the PlayStation physical release have been declared.

New Rainbow Six Game Has Permadeath
Upcoming Nintendo Switch 2 Physical Release Switches to Game Key-Cards, Cancels Orders
Rockstar Games Announces Brand-New Detail About GTA 6: Extended Look
New Official Sifu-Like Game with Gun Fu Officially Confirmed for Summer 2027

While the motivation for the change from Spike Chunsoft isn't clear, it lands at a particularly tumultuous time for gamers as the overall industry shifts its approach towards an all-digital landscape. Many in the community are more concerned than ever that digital copies of games and Game-Key Cards are merely licenses to play, not full ownership, and have expressed concerns about the future when download and authorization servers could potentially go down, or about the possibilities of purchases being revoked. These concerns haven't been unfounded, with Sony expected to delete hundreds of movies from the PlayStation Store later this year. Those who paid for any of those movies will lose access to them with no refunds.

item.title: Rockstar Games Announces Brand-New Detail About GTA 6: Extended Look
item.description:
Everyone is counting down to the debut of Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look on Netflix on August 27, and now Rockstar Games has confirmed a brand-new detail that would-be viewers should keep in mind ahead of time. It's uncertain why Rockstar Games didn't confirm this detail ahead of time, but it's ultimately a good thing for Grand Theft Auto 6 , so it's probably no big deal for tons of creators and fans.

As of this writing, Rockstar Games and Netflix's Extended Look at GTA 6 drops on August 27 at 12 pm PT/3 pm ET. It'll come to YouTube six hours later at 6 pm PT/9 pm ET, essentially making it a timed Netflix exclusive. Rockstar also recently confirmed that some creators will be able to produce previews of the upcoming open-world game, but many previously believed that any sort of streaming or group viewing would not be possible until it hit YT. That's not exactly the case.

Rockstar Officially Confirms New GTA 6 Gameplay Features

Developer Rockstar Games officially confirms a short list of upcoming gameplay features in Grand Theft Auto 6.

1
By Joshua Duckworth

GTA 6's Netflix Debut Okays Reaction Content

Following up on its initial August 6 tweet announcing the GTA 6 Extended Look, the official Rockstar Twitter account added that "creators can share their reaction content across social and video platforms." In other words, fans can expect an influx of short-form and long-form videos on YouTube and other social media platforms ahead of the official video later that night.

Any creator looking to do so should be sure their setup can record Netflix. As anyone who has ever tried knows, Netflix will often go black when any recording software is detected, but the workaround is quite simple.

Anyone looking to create reaction videos to GTA 6 tomorrow needs to disable hardware acceleration on Google Chrome and restart their browser. Simple is as simple does. Fans can expect their favorite content creators, perhaps even more, all to create reaction content for the GTA 6: Extended Look , so that's what's going to dominate every algorithm for the coming weekend at least. And hopefully the noise from that drowns out any leaked spoilers.

As many fans know, an individual or group known as Cyberleek has been sharing leaked gameplay videos of GTA 6 . That has only escalated with every post, with one of the latest including spoilers for Lucia's prologue in GTA 6 . Many would argue that most of their gameplay videos have been small and ultimately harmless, even if Rockstar and Take-Two disagree, but story spoilers cross a line. Unfortunately, it stands to reason that GTA 6 's Extended Look could be an excuse for Cyberleek to escalate.

item.title: Best Fortnite Override Sprite Loot Path (Chapter 7 Season 4 Cheat Code Farm Route)
item.description:
Fortnite Override Chapter 7 Season 4 is all about Sprites, again, bringing a bunch of Gaming Legends into the game as Sprites, along with some returning characters like Klombo. However, finding rare Sprites is tough this season. Luckily, here are the best locations and Sprite Cheat Code loot path to get Sprites fast in Fortnite .

How to Get the Meowscles Wrixel Style in Fortnite (Acquire Power Ups Quest)

The Meowscles Wrixel Style may just be the hardest reward to unlock for this season of Fortnite. Here is how to easily acquire Power Ups, fast.

By Nathan Round

Best Locations for Sprite Cheat Codes in Fortnite

Pretty much every named POI in Fortnite has dozens of potential Sprite Cheat Code spawns. However, you will want to prioritize heading to the ones with the most. Here is a rundown of the top locations based on how many possible Cheat Code spawns they have:

  • Heatwave Harbor: 75 Sprite Cheat Code Spawns
  • Cluster Coast: 67 Sprite Cheat Code Spawns
  • Shaken Sanctuary: 42 Sprite Cheat Code Spawns
  • Building east of Blinky Island: 36 Sprite Cheat Code Spawns
  • The Battlewoods: 36 Sprite Cheat Code Spawns
  • Chopped Shop: 33 Sprite Cheat Code Spawns
  • Stone Sanctum: 32 Sprite Cheat Code Spawns

Best Sprite Loot Path in Fortnite

The Battlewoods to Chopped Shop

  1. Loot the Golden Reel Theater, the buildings south, the buildings on the north-east corner, and the west and east of The Battlewoods.
  2. Head through Ol' Stumpy to the west and loot Cheat Codes along the way, including the shipping containers with the Slurp Truck west of Battlewoods.
  3. Loot along the two mountains south-east of Chopped Shop.
  4. Loot all the buildings in Chopped Shop.

Heatwave Harbor to Mega Maze

  1. All buildings in Heatwave Harbor have potential spawns. The highest number of spawns are in the two buildings to the east, the red building to the west, and the building by the swimming pool to the south.
  2. Push south, hit the RVs and the house by Blinky Island, and then head to the building to the east for 36 possible spawns.
  3. Push through Sunken Shores and hit the buildings along the way. The highest number of spawns are at the restaurant to the east and the buildings on the south-east corner.
  4. Finish at Mega Maze. The most spawns are on the south and east side.

Wettest-Bones Research Facility to Shaken Sanctuary

  1. Start at the Wettest-Bones Research Facility. Concentrate on the main house for 16 possible spawns.
  2. Push down to Crash Out Estates. Focus on spawns towards the north and the east before the zipline.
  3. Zipline to Cluster Coast. Start at the duck yacht and then loot the south building, east building, and north building.
  4. Push to the beachside building to the far north-east for 18 possible spawns.
  5. Finish at Shaken Sanctuary. You can find the biggest concentration in the center and the greenhouse north-east.
